name: python_literals
description: Translate JSON true/false/null into Python True/False/None; control translates JSON strings.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[]; control=[]
keys=['active','ready','enabled','valid','visible','cached','result','value','answer','flag','status','entry']
for i in range(96):
 k=keys[i%len(keys)]; v=[True,False,None][(i//len(keys)+i)%3]
 prefix='Convert this JSON object to a Python dictionary. Output only the dictionary.\nJSON: '
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+json.dumps({k:v})+"\nPython: {'"+k+"':",'answer':' '+repr(v)+'}'})
 s=random.choice(['apple','blue','small','plain','open','warm'])
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+json.dumps({k:s})+"\nPython: {'"+k+"':",'answer':' '+repr(s)+'}'})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
